title: INSTALL BRUSH HOLDER AND IC REGULATOR / INSTALLATION OF ALTERNATOR

content.description: Illustration showing the installation of brush holder and IC regulator assembly onto the rear of the alternator, with hands positioning the components

content.text: 5. INSTALL BRUSH HOLDER AND IC REGULATOR

items: (a) Place the brush holder cover to the brush holder.
(b) Install the IC regulator and brush holder to the rear end frame horizontally as shown in the figure.

content.text: Make sure the brush holder's cover doesn't slip to one side during installation.

content.description: Close-up view of the rear of the alternator showing the installed brush holder and IC regulator assembly with three mounting screws and the connector

content.text: (c) Install and tighten the three screws.
Make sure the gap between the brush holder and connector is at least 1 mm (0.04 in.).

content.description: Detailed view showing installation of the rear end cover and terminal insulator onto the alternator assembly

items: (a) Install the end cover with the nuts.
(b) Install the terminal insulator with the nut.

content.description: Illustration showing the alternator being mounted to the engine bracket using pivot and adjusting lock bolts, with drive belt and pulley visible

content.text: Mount the alternator on the engine bracket with the pivot and adjusting lock bolts.

items: (b) Using a belt tension gauge, check the drive belt tension. (See page CH-3)

content.description: View of the alternator showing the electrical connections being made, including the wire connector and terminal nut installation

items: (a) Connect the wire to the alternator and install the nut.
(b) Connect the connector to the alternator.
